translations.literal: (Qianyuan: count days after spring and autumn equinoxes plus entry-into-qi day; multiply by fifteen; if ninety and below, multiply by ninety-one, retreat for general difference;
translations.idiomatic: (In Qianyuan: count post-equinox days plus entry-into-qi day, ×15; if ≤90, ×91 and retreat for general difference;

sentences.zh: 九十一以上去之，餘以九十一乘，退一等，以減八百一十九，為泛差；

translations.literal: if ninety-one and above, remove it; remainder multiply by ninety-one, retreat one place; subtract from eight hundred nineteen—for general difference;
translations.idiomatic: If ≥91, remove; remainder ×91, retreat one place; subtract from 819 for general difference;

sentences.zh: 二分氣內置入氣日，以九十一乘，退為泛差；

translations.literal: within equinox qi set entry-into-qi day; multiply by ninety-one, retreat for general difference;
translations.idiomatic: Within equinox qi, set entry-into-qi day, ×91 and retreat for general difference;

sentences.zh: 以半晝刻而一，以乘距午分，用加減泛差，為離差；

translations.literal: take one per half day clepsydra marks; multiply by distance-from-noon parts; add and subtract general difference—for apogee difference;
translations.idiomatic: Divide by half-day clepsydra marks, × distance-from-noon parts, add/subtract general difference for apogee difference;

sentences.zh: 食甚在出沒以前者，不用求離差，只用泛差，春分後陰加陽減，秋分後陰減陽加。

translations.literal: If eclipse greatest is before rising-setting, do not use finding apogee difference; use only general difference; after spring equinox yin add yang subtract, after autumn equinox yin subtract yang add.
translations.idiomatic: If greatest eclipse is before rising/setting, use only general difference; after spring equinox yin add/yang subtract, after autumn equinox yin subtract/yang add.

translations.idiomatic: In Yitian: post-equinox increase to solstices reaches accumulated difference 2,826; then cumulative decrease to equinox zero; winter-solstice daily −31, 80 minor parts; summer-solstice daily +30, 15 minor parts; × accumulated difference by lineage divisor, ÷ surplus/deficit initial/terminal limits for daily difference;

sentences.zh: 乃以末限累增、初限累損，各為每日食差；

translations.literal: then with terminal limit cumulative increase, initial limit cumulative decrease—each becomes daily eclipse difference;
translations.idiomatic: Terminal limit cumulative increase and initial limit cumulative decrease yield daily eclipse difference;

sentences.zh: 又以半晝刻數約其日食差，以乘食甚距午正刻，所得以減食差，餘為定數。

translations.literal: again reduce that day eclipse difference by half day clepsydra mark count; multiply by eclipse greatest distance-from-noon true clepsydra marks; subtract the product from eclipse difference—the remainder is fixed number.
translations.idiomatic: Reduce daily eclipse difference by half-day clepsydra count, × greatest-eclipse distance-from-noon true marks, subtract from eclipse difference for fixed number.

translations.idiomatic: Set pre/post-conjunction parts; apply Yellow Path and equator differences for distance-from-conjunction parts.

sentences.zh: 如月在內道不足減者，返減入外道，不食；

translations.literal: If the moon is on the inner path and insufficient to subtract, reverse-subtract to enter the outer path—no eclipse;
translations.idiomatic: If the moon is on the inner path and subtraction is insufficient, reverse-subtract to the outer path—no eclipse;

sentences.zh: 如月在外道不足減，返減食差，為返減入內道即有食。

translations.literal: if the moon is on the outer path and insufficient to subtract, reverse-subtract eclipse difference—reverse-subtract to enter inner path then there is eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: If on the outer path and subtraction is insufficient, reverse-subtract eclipse difference—reverse-subtract to inner path and there is eclipse.

sentences.zh: （《乾元》置陰陽曆去交前後分，以食差合加減者，依其加減，所得為去交前後定分。

translations.idiomatic: (In Qianyuan: set yin-yang table pre/post-conjunction parts; apply combined eclipse-difference add/subtract for fixed pre/post-conjunction parts.

translations.idiomatic: Moon in yin table: if pre/post-conjunction parts insufficient, reverse-subtract eclipse difference; pre-conjunction subtract—remainder to yang table post-conjunction; both outside eclipse limit.

sentences.zh: 月在陽曆，去交前後分不足減者，亦返減食差，交前減之，餘者為陰曆交後定分，交後減之，餘者為陰曆交前定分，併入食限。

translations.literal: Moon in yang table, departure-from-conjunction pre- and post-parts insufficient to subtract—also reverse-subtract eclipse difference; pre-conjunction subtract it—the remainder is yin table post-conjunction fixed parts; post-conjunction subtract it—the remainder is yin table pre-conjunction fixed parts; both enter eclipse limit.
translations.idiomatic: Moon in yang table: if insufficient, reverse-subtract eclipse difference; pre-conjunction subtract for yin post-conjunction fixed parts; post-conjunction subtract for yin pre-conjunction fixed parts; both in eclipse limit.

translations.idiomatic: Each retreat one place; subtract from yin-yang table parts for eclipse fixed parts;

sentences.zh: 如不足減，即返減之，餘進一位，加陰曆分，為食定分；

translations.literal: if insufficient to subtract, then reverse-subtract it; remainder advance one place; add yin table parts—for eclipse fixed parts;
translations.idiomatic: If insufficient, reverse-subtract; advance remainder one place; add yin-table parts for eclipse fixed parts;

sentences.zh: 陽以四十二除，為食之大分；

translations.literal: yang: divide by forty-two—for eclipse major parts;
translations.idiomatic: Yang: divide by 42 for eclipse major parts;

sentences.zh: 陰九百六十以下返減之，如九十六而一，為食之大分，命十為限。

translations.idiomatic: Yin: if ≤960 reverse-subtract; divide by 96 for eclipse major parts; name 10 as limit.

sentences.zh: （《乾元》置交前後分，以食差加減之，為定交分；

translations.literal: (Qianyuan: set pre- and post-conjunction parts; add and subtract eclipse difference—for fixed conjunction parts;
translations.idiomatic: (In Qianyuan: set pre/post-conjunction parts; apply eclipse difference for fixed conjunction parts;

sentences.zh: 在九百二十以下為陽，以上去之為陰。

translations.literal: if nine hundred twenty and below it is yang; if above, remove it—for yin.
translations.idiomatic: If ≤920 it is yang; if above, remove for yin.

sentences.zh: 在陽以九十四、在陰以二百一十三除為大分，餘同《應天》。

translations.literal: In yang divide by ninety-four; in yin divide by two hundred thirteen for major parts; remainder follows Yingtian.
translations.idiomatic: In yang divide by 94; in yin by 213 for major parts; remainder as in Yingtian.

sentences.zh: 《儀天》置入限去交定分，減七百二十八，陽限以上為陰曆食，以陽限去之，餘減陰限為陰曆食分，以下者為陽曆食分，亦減三百一十七，如限除之，皆進一位，各命十為限，餘同《應天》。）〉

translations.idiomatic: Lunar eclipse magnitude: set Yellow Path inner/outer pre/post parts; if ≤ eclipse limit 340, totality;

translations.idiomatic: If above, reverse-subtract terminal standard; divide remainder by 121 for lunar eclipse major parts.

translations.idiomatic: Convert eclipse major/minor parts by 100; multiply by 1,337; each by that day apogee parts for fixed-use parts;

sentences.zh: 加食定餘，為復末定分；

translations.literal: add eclipse fixed remainder—for last-return fixed parts;
translations.idiomatic: Add eclipse fixed remainder for last-return fixed parts;

sentences.zh: 減之，為虧初定分。

translations.literal: subtract it—for first-loss fixed parts.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract for first-loss fixed parts.

sentences.zh: 其月食，以食限減定用分，用減食甚，為虧初定分；

translations.literal: For lunar eclipse, subtract fixed-use parts from eclipse limit; use to subtract from eclipse greatest—for first-loss fixed parts;
translations.idiomatic: For lunar eclipse: subtract fixed-use parts from eclipse limit and from greatest eclipse for first-loss fixed parts;

sentences.zh: 如不足減者，即以食限分如望定餘為食定分，餘卻依日食加減，各得月食虧初、复末定分也。

translations.literal: if insufficient to subtract, then use eclipse limit parts like full-moon fixed remainder for eclipse fixed parts; remainder then follows solar eclipse addition-subtraction—each obtains lunar eclipse first-loss and last-return fixed parts.
translations.idiomatic: If insufficient, use eclipse limit parts like full-moon fixed remainder; remainder follows solar eclipse add/subtract for lunar first-loss and last-return fixed parts.

sentences.zh: （《儀天》月以五百八十八，日以五百二十九、秒二十乘所食分，退一等，半之，為定用刻。

translations.literal: (Yitian: moon use five hundred eighty-eight, sun use five hundred twenty-nine, seconds twenty multiply eclipse parts; retreat one place, halve—for fixed-use clepsydra marks.
translations.idiomatic: (In Yitian: moon use 588, sun use 529, 20 seconds × eclipse parts; retreat one place, halve for fixed-use clepsydra marks.

sentences.zh: 《儀天》日以五百四十五、秒四十，月以六百六，皆乘所食分，其小分以本母除，從之，為泛用分；

translations.literal: Yitian: sun use five hundred forty-five, seconds forty; moon use six hundred six; each multiply eclipse parts; minor parts divide by original mother and follow—for general-use parts;
translations.idiomatic: In Yitian: sun 545, 40 seconds; moon 606; each × eclipse parts; minor parts ÷ original mother for general-use parts;

sentences.zh: 其食又視去交定分在一千七百二十六以下增半刻，八百五十六以下又增半刻，以一千三百五十乘，以辰定分除，為定用刻；

translations.literal: For eclipse also observe departure-from-conjunction fixed parts one thousand seven hundred twenty-six and below add half clepsydra mark; eight hundred fifty-six and below again add half clepsydra mark; multiply by one thousand three hundred fifty; divide by chen fixed parts—for fixed-use clepsydra marks;
translations.idiomatic: Also if departure-from-conjunction fixed parts ≤1,726 add half mark; if ≤856 add another half mark; ×1,350, ÷ chen fixed parts for fixed-use clepsydra marks;

sentences.zh: 皆減定朔、望小餘為虧初，加之為復末。）〉

translations.literal: each subtract from fixed new-moon and full-moon minor remainder for first loss; add for last return.)
translations.idiomatic: Subtract from fixed new/full-moon minor remainder for first loss; add for last return.)

sentences.zh: 日食起虧：

translations.literal: Solar eclipse first loss direction:
translations.idiomatic: Solar Eclipse First-Loss Direction:

sentences.zh: （《乾元》謂之求日食初起。）〉

translations.literal: (The Qianyuan [calendar] calls this finding solar eclipse initial rise.)
translations.idiomatic: (Qianyuan calls this finding solar eclipse initial direction.)

sentences.zh: 視距交分如四百二十以上者，初起西北，甚於正北，復於東北；

translations.literal: Observe distance-from-conjunction parts: if like four hundred twenty and above, initial rise northwest, greatest at true north, return at northeast;
translations.idiomatic: If distance-from-conjunction parts ≥420: first loss northwest, greatest at true north, return northeast;

sentences.zh: 如以下者，初起西南，甚於正南，復於東南。

translations.literal: if like below, initial rise southwest, greatest at true south, return at southeast.
translations.idiomatic: If below: first loss southwest, greatest at true south, return southeast.

sentences.zh: 凡食八分以上者​​，皆初起正西，復於正東。

translations.literal: Whenever eclipse eight parts and above, each initial rise true west, return at true east.
translations.idiomatic: For eclipses ≥8 parts: first loss due west, return due east.

sentences.zh: （《儀天》、《乾元》日在陰曆，初起西北；

translations.literal: (Yitian and Qianyuan: sun in yin table, initial rise northwest;
translations.idiomatic: (In Yitian and Qianyuan: sun in yin table, first loss northwest;

sentences.zh: 在陽曆，初起西南，餘並同《應天》。）〉

translations.literal: in yang table, initial rise southwest; remainder all follows Yingtian.)
translations.idiomatic: in yang table, first loss southwest; remainder as in Yingtian.)

sentences.zh: 月食起虧：

translations.literal: Lunar eclipse first loss direction:
translations.idiomatic: Lunar Eclipse First-Loss Direction:

sentences.zh: （《乾元》謂之月食初定，《儀天》謂之月食初起。）〉

translations.literal: (The Qianyuan [calendar] calls this lunar eclipse initial fixed; the Yitian [calendar] calls it lunar eclipse initial rise.)
translations.idiomatic: (Qianyuan calls this lunar eclipse initial fixed; Yitian calls it lunar eclipse initial direction.)

sentences.zh: 月在內道，初起東南，甚於正南，復於西南；

translations.literal: Moon on inner path, initial rise southeast, greatest at true south, return at southwest;
translations.idiomatic: Moon on inner path: first loss southeast, greatest at true south, return southwest;

sentences.zh: 月在外道，初起東北，甚於正北，復於西北。

translations.literal: moon on outer path, initial rise northeast, greatest at true north, return at northwest.
translations.idiomatic: Moon on outer path: first loss northeast, greatest at true north, return northwest.

sentences.zh: 凡食八分以上者​​，初起正東，復於正西。

translations.literal: Whenever eclipse eight parts and above, initial rise true east, return at true west.
translations.idiomatic: For eclipses ≥8 parts: first loss due east, return due west.

sentences.zh: （《乾元》《儀天》以內道為陰曆，外道為陽曆，餘皆同《應天》。

translations.literal: (Qianyuan and Yitian take inner path as yin table, outer path as yang table; remainder all follows Yingtian.
translations.idiomatic: (In Qianyuan and Yitian, inner path is yin table and outer path is yang table; remainder as in Yingtian.

sentences.zh: 而《儀天》又法雲，此法據古經所載，以究天體，食在午中前後一辰之內，其餘方若要的驗，當視日月食時所在方位高下，審祥黃道斜正、月行所向，起虧、复滿皆可知也。）〉

translations.literal: But Yitian also notes in method: this method according to ancient classics records investigates the celestial body; eclipse within one chen before and after noon, other directions if essential to verify, should observe solar-lunar eclipse time location direction height, examine Yellow Path obliquity, moon motion direction—first loss and last return fullness all can be known.)
translations.idiomatic: Yitian also notes: this method follows ancient classics to investigate the heavens; within one chen of noon, for other directions observe eclipse-time location and altitude, examine Yellow Path obliquity and lunar motion—first loss and last return can all be determined.)

sentences.zh: 帶食出入：

translations.literal: Eclipse at rising-setting:
translations.idiomatic: Eclipse at Rising or Setting:

sentences.zh: （《儀天》謂之求帶食出入見食分數。）〉

translations.literal: (The Yitian [calendar] calls this finding eclipse-at-rising-setting visible eclipse parts.)
translations.idiomatic: (Yitian calls this finding visible eclipse magnitude at rising or setting.)

sentences.zh: 視其日出入分，如在虧初定分以上、复末定分以下，即帶食出入。

translations.literal: Observe that day rising-setting parts; if between first-loss fixed parts and above, last-return fixed parts and below, then eclipse at rising-setting.
translations.idiomatic: If rising-setting parts fall between first-loss and last-return fixed parts, it is an eclipse at rising or setting.

sentences.zh: 食甚在出入分以下，以出入分減复末定分，為帶食差；

translations.literal: If eclipse greatest below rising-setting parts, subtract rising-setting parts from last-return fixed parts—for eclipse-at-rising-setting difference;
translations.idiomatic: If greatest eclipse is below rising-setting parts, subtract rising-setting parts from last-return fixed parts for the difference;

sentences.zh: 食甚在出入分以上者，以虧初定分減出入分，為帶食差；

translations.literal: if eclipse greatest above rising-setting parts, subtract rising-setting parts from first-loss fixed parts—for eclipse-at-rising-setting difference;
translations.idiomatic: If above rising-setting parts, subtract rising-setting parts from first-loss fixed parts for the difference;

sentences.zh: 以乘食定分，滿定用而一，日陽以四十二、陰以九十六、月一百二十一除之，為帶食之大分，餘為小分。

translations.literal: multiply by eclipse fixed parts; take one per fixed-use; sun yang divide by forty-two, yin by ninety-six, moon by one hundred twenty-one—for eclipse-at-rising-setting major parts, remainder minor parts.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply by eclipse fixed parts, divide by fixed-use; sun yang ÷42, yin ÷96, moon ÷121 for major parts (remainder minor parts).

sentences.zh: （《乾元》各以食甚餘與其日晨昏分相減，餘為帶食差；

translations.literal: (Qianyuan: each subtract that day dawn-dusk parts from eclipse greatest remainder—the remainder is eclipse-at-rising-setting difference;
translations.idiomatic: (In Qianyuan: subtract dawn/dusk parts from greatest-eclipse remainder for the difference;

sentences.zh: 其帶食差在定用刻以下者，即帶食出入；

translations.literal: if eclipse-at-rising-setting difference below fixed-use clepsydra marks, then eclipse at rising-setting;
translations.idiomatic: If the difference is below fixed-use clepsydra marks, it is eclipse at rising/setting;

sentences.zh: 以上者，即不帶食出入也。

translations.literal: if above, then not eclipse at rising-setting.
translations.idiomatic: If above, it is not eclipse at rising/setting.

sentences.zh: 以帶食差乘所食之分，滿定用刻而一，所得以減所食之分，即帶食出入所見之分也。

translations.literal: Multiply eclipse-at-rising-setting difference by eclipsed parts; take one per fixed-use clepsydra marks; subtract the product from eclipsed parts—this is eclipse-at-rising-setting visible parts.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply difference by eclipsed parts, divide by fixed-use clepsydra marks, subtract from eclipsed parts for visible magnitude at rising/setting.

sentences.zh: 其朔日食甚在晝者，晨為已食之分，昏為所殘之分；

translations.literal: For new-moon day eclipse greatest in daytime, dawn is already-eclipsed parts, dusk is remaining parts;
translations.idiomatic: For new-moon solar eclipse in daytime: dawn is already-eclipsed portion, dusk is remaining portion;

sentences.zh: 若食甚在夜，昏為已食之分，晨為所殘之分。

translations.literal: if eclipse greatest at night, dusk is already-eclipsed parts, dawn is remaining parts.
translations.idiomatic: If at night: dusk is already-eclipsed, dawn is remaining.

sentences.zh: 其月食，見此可以知之也。

translations.literal: For lunar eclipse, seeing this one can know it.
translations.idiomatic: For lunar eclipses, the same principle applies.

sentences.zh: 《儀天》以食甚餘減晨昏分，餘為出入前分，不足者，返減食甚，餘為出入後分，以乘所食之分，其食分以本母通之，從其小分，滿定用分除之，所得以本母約之，不滿者，半以上為半強，半以下為半弱，即得帶食出入之分數也。

translations.literal: Yitian: subtract dawn-dusk parts from eclipse greatest remainder—the remainder is before-rising-setting parts; if insufficient, reverse-subtract eclipse greatest—the remainder is after-rising-setting parts; multiply by eclipsed parts; convert eclipsed parts by original mother and follow minor parts; divide by fixed-use parts; reduce the product by original mother; insufficient: half and above is half-strong, half and below is half-weak—this yields eclipse-at-rising-setting parts count.
translations.idiomatic: In Yitian: subtract dawn/dusk from greatest-eclipse remainder for before-rising-setting parts (reverse-subtract if insufficient for after-rising-setting); × eclipsed parts; convert and divide by fixed-use; reduce; round half-strong/half-weak for visible magnitude at rising/setting.

sentences.zh: 其日、月食甚在出入前者，為所殘之分，在出入後者，為已退之分。）〉

translations.literal: Solar-lunar eclipse greatest before rising-setting is remaining parts; after rising-setting is already-retreated parts.)
translations.idiomatic: Greatest eclipse before rising/setting is remaining portion; after rising/setting is already-retreated portion.)

sentences.zh: 更點：

translations.literal: Watch bells:
translations.idiomatic: Watch Bells:

sentences.zh: （《乾元》、《儀天》謂之月食入定點。）〉

translations.literal: (Qianyuan and Yitian call this lunar eclipse entry into fixed bells.)
translations.idiomatic: (Qianyuan and Yitian call this lunar eclipse fixed bell-points.)

sentences.zh: 各置虧初、食甚、复末定分，如晨分以下者加晨分，昏分以上者減去昏分，皆以更分除為更數，不盡，以點分除之為點數。

translations.literal: Each set first-loss, eclipse greatest, last-return fixed parts; if like morning parts and below add morning parts; if dusk parts and above subtract dusk parts; each divide by watch parts for watch count; insufficient divide by bell parts for bell count.
translations.idiomatic: Set first-loss, greatest, and last-return fixed parts; add morning parts if ≤ morning parts, subtract dusk parts if ≥ dusk parts; divide by watch parts for watch count, by bell parts for bell count.

sentences.zh: 命初更，算外，即得所求。

translations.literal: Name from first watch, outside the count—this yields the desired result.
translations.idiomatic: Name from the first watch, outside the count.

sentences.zh: （《乾元》法同。

translations.literal: (The Qianyuan method is the same.
translations.idiomatic: (The Qianyuan method is identical.

sentences.zh: 《儀天》倍其日晨分，以五除之為更分，又以五除之為點分。

translations.literal: Yitian: double that day morning parts; divide by five for watch parts; again divide by five for bell parts.
translations.idiomatic: In Yitian: double that day morning parts; ÷5 for watch parts, again ÷5 for bell parts.

sentences.zh: 乃視所求小餘，如晨分以下加晨分，昏分以上減去昏分，求更點並同《應天》。）〉

translations.literal: Then observe sought minor remainder; if like morning parts and below add morning parts; if dusk parts and above subtract dusk parts; finding watch bells all follows Yingtian.)
translations.idiomatic: Observe sought minor remainder; add morning or subtract dusk parts as above; watch bells as in Yingtian.)

sentences.zh: 日月食宿分：

translations.literal: Solar-lunar eclipse lodge lodging parts:
translations.idiomatic: Solar and Lunar Eclipse Lodge Positions:

sentences.zh: （《乾元》謂之日月食宿。）〉

translations.literal: (The Qianyuan [calendar] calls this solar-lunar eclipse lodge lodging.)
translations.idiomatic: (Qianyuan calls this solar-lunar eclipse lodge position.)

sentences.zh: 以天正冬至黃道日度加朔望常日月度，命起鬥初，算外，即日月食在宿分也。

translations.literal: Add celestial-standard winter solstice Yellow Path solar degree to new-moon and full-moon regular-day lunar degree; name from Dipper initial, outside the count—this is solar-lunar eclipse lodge parts.
translations.idiomatic: Add celestial-standard winter-solstice Yellow Path solar degree to new/full-moon regular lunar degree; name from Dipper initial, outside the count, for eclipse lodge position.

sentences.zh: （《乾元》以距日沒辰至食甚辰之數，約其日離差，用加昏度。

translations.literal: (Qianyuan: with the count from distance-from-sunset chen to eclipse greatest chen, reduce that day apogee difference, use to add to dusk degree.
translations.idiomatic: (In Qianyuan: count from sunset chen to greatest-eclipse chen, reduce that day apogee difference, add to dusk degree.

sentences.zh: 《儀天》用加時定月度也。）〉

translations.literal: Yitian uses hour-added fixed lunar degree.)
translations.idiomatic: Yitian uses hour-added fixed lunar degree.)
